worker.name: Worker
worker.desc: Builds structures, mines deposits, clears forests.

rocketSoldier.name: Rocket Squad
rocketSoldier.desc: Anti-armor infantry. Shreds tanks; can reach helicopters.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: Extreme range, devastating single shots. Keep out of sight.

commando.name: Commando
commando.desc: Elite infantry. Expensive, fast and deadly in small squads.

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.desc: Longest ground range in the game, splash damage. Escort it.

aaVehicle.name: AA Vehicle
aaVehicle.desc: Rapid flak cannons — melts helicopters, jets and bombers.

samLauncher.name: SAM Launcher
samLauncher.desc: Long-range missile vehicle. Builds a serious no-fly zone.

jet.name: Strike Jet
jet.desc: Devastating strikes, good in dogfights. Glass cannon.

bomber.name: Heavy Bomber
bomber.desc: Carpet bombing with wide splash. Slow — bring escorts.

drone.name: Combat Drone
drone.desc: Cheap airborne scout-striker. Fragile, fast, excellent for harassment.

gunboat.name: Gunboat
gunboat.desc: Fast coastal patrol boat with AA guns. Water only.

submarine.name: Submarine
submarine.desc: Torpedo attacks tear ships apart. Requires Naval Engineering.

destroyer.name: Destroyer
destroyer.desc: Heavy warship with long-range guns. Requires Naval Engineering.

apc.name: APC
apc.desc: Fast armored car with a chain gun — chews through infantry, screens your tanks.

mlrs.name: MLRS
mlrs.desc: Rocket barrage across a wide area from extreme range. Fragile — keep it behind the line.

gunship.name: Gunship
gunship.desc: Heavy attack helicopter: armored, sustained fire. The battlefield bully.

corvette.name: Missile Corvette
corvette.desc: Fast missile boat — punches far above its weight against ships and aircraft.

nuclearSub.name: Nuclear Submarine
nuclearSub.desc: Strategic missile submarine: torpedoes ships AND launches cruise/ballistic/nuclear missiles from your stockpile. Requires the Nuclear Program.

hq.name: Headquarters
hq.desc: Your capital district and the source of the road and railway supply network. Trains workers. If it falls, you lose.

villageCenter.name: Village Center
villageCenter.desc: Founds a village of houses on one hex, with a 40-range construction district. Connect it to the capital by road or rail to supply its production.

cityCenter.name: City Center
cityCenter.desc: Founds a city district on one hex and opens a 62-range construction area. Requires Urban Planning and a road or rail connection to the capital for supply.

workerHouse.name: Worker Lodge
workerHouse.desc: Trains workers who construct buildings and mine deposits.

housing.name: Housing Block
housing.desc: +8 army capacity. Soldiers need somewhere to sleep.

residential.name: Residential District
residential.desc: +150 civilian capacity. More citizens = more taxpayers.

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: +2 food/s. Feeds citizens and the army.

foodDepot.name: Food Warehouse
foodDepot.desc: +5 happiness, +500 food storage. Hungry citizens riot.

warehouse.name: Storage Warehouse
warehouse.desc: +400 storage for oil, iron, silicon & uranium.

extractor.name: Extractor (Mine / Rig)
extractor.desc: Build on a resource deposit to extract it automatically.

powerPlant.name: Power Plant
powerPlant.desc: +20 MW, +15% production & construction speed (stacks up to +30%).

nuclearReactor.name: Nuclear Reactor
nuclearReactor.desc: +40 MW & +20% production & +$5/s while fueled (0.04 uranium/s). MELTDOWN if destroyed. Required for the Nuclear Program.

market.name: Market
market.desc: +8% income, +3 happiness. Enables instant buy/sell on the World Market and +1 commercial contract.

port.name: Commercial Port
port.desc: Required for overseas trade. Handles 2 shipping routes; cargo takes time to arrive and can be lost at sea. Must touch the coast.

cottage.name: Cottage Row
cottage.desc: +80 civilian capacity, +2 happiness. Cozy starter homes for a young nation.

apartments.name: Apartment Tower
apartments.desc: +280 civilian capacity, -1 happiness. Mass housing = mass taxpayers.

luxuryVillas.name: Luxury Villas
luxuryVillas.desc: +60 capacity, +5 happiness, +4% income (max +16%). The wealthy pay well.

techPark.name: Tech Park
techPark.desc: +0.8 research/s, +5% income. Unlocks the Microchip Fabrication discovery.

chipFab.name: Chip Fab
chipFab.desc: Consumes 0.05 silicon/s → +$6/s and +0.4 research/s. Requires Microchip Fabrication.

cityHall.name: City Hall
cityHall.desc: +10% income, +6 happiness. The seat of local government.

school.name: School
school.desc: +8 education → smarter citizens earn more, research faster.

university.name: University
university.desc: +1 research/s, +10 education. Gateway to great discoveries.

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.desc: +10 health → productive citizens; heals nearby units.

policeStation.name: Police Station
policeStation.desc: +10 public order. Low order breeds crime and lost income.

park.name: City Park
park.desc: +6 happiness, +2 culture. Everyone loves a picnic.

stadium.name: Stadium
stadium.desc: +8 happiness, +5 culture, +3% income. Bread and games.

tvStation.name: TV Station
tvStation.desc: +8 government approval, +3 culture. Controls the narrative.

intelAgency.name: Intelligence Agency
intelAgency.desc: Unlocks covert operations. Recruit agents here. +10% op success.

ammoDepot.name: Ammo Depot
ammoDepot.desc: +5% unit damage (max +25%), -6% reload time for ALL units (max -18%), stores +4 missiles.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains infantry: riflemen, rocket squads, snipers and commandos.

tankFactory.name: Tank Factory
tankFactory.desc: Produces tanks, APCs, artillery, MLRS, anti-air vehicles and SAM launchers.

helipad.name: Helipad
helipad.desc: Builds attack helicopters and heavy gunships.

airfield.name: Airfield
airfield.desc: Air base with 4 plane slots. Jets & bombers fly missions from here and return to rearm.

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.desc: Builds warships. Must be built on the coastline.

missileSilo.name: Missile Silo
missileSilo.desc: Produces tactical, cruise, cluster, EMP, anti-ship, strategic and nuclear missiles (stored in Ammo Depots).

commandCenter.name: Command & Control
commandCenter.desc: +10 army morale, +10% unit HP. Coordinates the war effort.

samSite.name: SAM Site
samSite.desc: Automated anti-air battery: shoots down enemy planes, helicopters and drones in range.

bunker.name: Bunker
bunker.desc: Hardened strongpoint: friendly infantry within 15 range take 30% less damage.

solarFarm.name: Solar Farm
solarFarm.desc: +8 MW of clean power. The grid feeds every factory, lab and radar.

oilRefinery.name: Oil Refinery
oilRefinery.desc: Consumes 0.06 oil/s → +$7/s. Industry runs on crude.

offshoreRig.name: Offshore Rig
offshoreRig.desc: Sea platform built on an Offshore Oil Field (builds itself — no worker needed). Requires Offshore Drilling.

fishingWharf.name: Fishing Wharf
fishingWharf.desc: +2 food/s from the sea, +2 more per Fish School within 60 range (max +4). Must touch the coast.

mountainMine.name: Mountain Mine
mountainMine.desc: Dig iron straight out of the high rock: +0.8 iron/s. Must be built on mountainous ground (elevation).

waterTreatment.name: Water Treatment
waterTreatment.desc: +6 health, +100 civilian capacity. Clean water, healthy city.

museum.name: National Museum
museum.desc: +6 culture, +4 happiness. A nation with a story fights for it.

courthouse.name: Courthouse
courthouse.desc: +8 public order, +5% income. Rule of law pays dividends.

tactical.name: Tactical Missile
tactical.desc: Cheap battlefield missile. Small blast, quick to produce.

cruise.name: Cruise Missile
cruise.desc: Precision strike. Flies low and fast to the target.

cluster.name: Cluster Missile
cluster.desc: Wide anti-unit spread. Weak against hardened buildings.

emp.name: EMP Missile
emp.desc: Disables vehicles, aircraft, ships and buildings in the blast for 35s.

antiShip.name: Anti-Ship Missile
antiShip.desc: Sea-skimming missile. Devastating against naval targets.

ballistic.name: Ballistic Missile
ballistic.desc: Massive warhead on a high arc. Requires Ballistic Technology.

hypersonic.name: Hypersonic Missile
hypersonic.desc: Very fast precision strategic missile. Smaller blast than ballistic, harder to react to.

nuke.name: Nuclear Missile
nuke.desc: City-killer. Massive blast; the entire world will condemn its use.

buildNetwork.name: Build Network
buildNetwork.desc: Recruit assets and build a long-term infiltration network in the target nation.

reconDossier.name: Recon Dossier
reconDossier.desc: Produce a detailed target report: army strength, money, buildings and diplomatic state.

cyberAttack.name: Cyber Attack
cyberAttack.desc: Disable production and power systems for 90 seconds.

stealFunds.name: Steal Funds
stealFunds.desc: Siphon money from the target treasury.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.desc: Cripple a random enemy structure (heavy damage).

proxyCell.name: Fund Proxy Cell
proxyCell.desc: A proxy cell disrupts their economy for 3 minutes.

armRebels.name: Arm Rebels
armRebels.desc: Create internal unrest: economy suffers and random facilities take damage.

falseFlag.name: False Flag
falseFlag.desc: Frame the target for aggression. Damages their relations and may start a foreign crisis.

assassinate.name: Assassination
assassinate.desc: Eliminate a key figure. Massive fallout if traced.

president.label: Head of State
president.effect: Their entire economy -35% for 4 min. May trigger war.

general.label: Top General
general.effect: Their units deal -30% damage for 4 min.
